dict.string: MediaLake indexes the folders you choose so you can search them by content. Files on the Desktop are only read if you add that folder.
MediaLake indexes the folders you choose so you can search them by content. Files in Documents are only read if you add that folder.
MediaLake indexes the folders you choose so you can search them by content. Files in Downloads are only read if you add that folder.
MediaLake reads files on external drives only if you add a folder from one to the index.
MediaLake reads files on network volumes only if you add a folder from one to the index.
MediaLake reads files in iCloud Drive and other cloud folders only if you add such a folder to the index.
